verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a financial-data platform like MX, but the evidence does not document a way to export all of a customer's data held in MX in open formats so they can leave. The API retrieves end-user financial data, FDX sharing is a data-holder open-finance feature, and PDF statements are an adjacent capability, so none of these is a documented full-account export or exit path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
